ARC and RICOCHET no longer waste hits when no other enemy is around: they strike the same one again at half damage. The REGEN tattoo no longer counts the MAX HP tattoo, so the two together no longer run far ahead of every other build.
ARC strikes a little less often at high levels (every 4th shot at most instead of every 3rd), and OVERDRIVE recharges a bit slower.

ARMOR is simpler: it only blocks its share of every hit. The small flat block and the limit on how much one hit can take are gone, so MAX HP always counts in full: twice the health lasts twice as many hits. Defence styles had pulled ahead of every other style; now they stand level with the best of them.

ARMOR now also limits how much one hit can take: never more than the share you do not block (at most a quarter of your health with 75% blocked). Defence styles are no longer killed by a single boss touch. Without armor one hit can still take it all.
ARMOR's flat block now also grows with the enemies of each tier, so defense keeps up when you move to a higher tier.

ATK SPD is about twice as strong, FROST adds much less damage, EXECUTE's victim bursts onto the enemies around it, DEFENSE makes every heal stronger the more you block, and REGEN now counts the MAX HP tattoo (with lower values). Frozen enemies can now be pushed back.
